all_yellow.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v 4) 6 v)))))

intended.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (cellmap g (r c v) (if (and (= v 4) (zero? (mod c 3))) 6 v)))))

leftmost_yellow_origin.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let ((left (apply min
          (for*/list ((r (range 0 (rows g))) (c (range 0 (cols g))))
            (if (= (at g r c) 4) c (cols g))))))
    (cellmap g (r c v)
      (if (and (= v 4) (zero? (mod (- c left) 3))) 6 v)))))

period_six.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (cellmap g (r c v) (if (and (= v 4) (zero? (mod c 6))) 6 v)))))
